extracted.stage: Ongoing matrimonial proceedings, through to settlement or trial
extracted.summary: A solicitor enquires about £39,500 of funding for a client's representation in ongoing matrimonial proceedings where the matrimonial pot is around £338,000 and the other side controls the liquid assets.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and court handling the proceedings, the stage reached and any listed hearing dates, and details of the composition and valuation of the £338,000 in disputed assets. It would also help to have a costs estimate or budget supporting the £39,500 requested, together with your client's details for our standard checks. Once we have those we will review the matter and come back to you. Nothing in this email should be taken as an indication of whether funding will be offered or on what terms.
